nodes.speaker: character-commander
nodes.line: A heartbeat, slow and far away. Frost cracks on the glass in front of your face.

nodes.speaker: class-barbarian
nodes.line: Put your back into it. The door's half open and the slimes are already in the pipes.

nodes.speaker: class-knight
nodes.line: Wait. The lamps in here just came on. Who's down there?
